title: Leaked memo: Meta's Reality Labs is reorganizing staff into AI-native "pods" focused on specific outcomes, flattening the organization's leadership structure (Charles Rollet/Business Insider)
summary: Charles Rollet / Business Insider: Leaked memo: Meta's Reality Labs is reorganizing staff into AI-native “pods” focused on specific outcomes, flattening the organization's leadership structure — - A large division within Meta Reality Labs is undergoing an overhaul to become fully “AI-native.”
contentText:
Charles Rollet / Business Insider :

Leaked memo: Meta's Reality Labs is reorganizing staff into AI-native “pods” focused on specific outcomes, flattening the organization's leadership structure   —  - A large division within Meta Reality Labs is undergoing an overhaul to become fully “AI-native.”
